evidence_quotes.quote: Governance of food and nutrition security in Eswatini: an analysis of government policies and reports
The data analysis focused on the strength of nutrition governance, actors involved in policymaking, nutrition-specific and sensitive-programs, and multisectoral coordination of programs.
The nutrition-sensitive initiatives included programs on school nutrition, sanitation and hygiene, agriculture production, and healthcare.

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Identical exclusion under both Criterion 2 readings: although the paper analyses policy and governance documents, its subject is food and nutrition security governance (mentioning sanitation and hygiene only in passing as one type of nutrition-sensitive program) with no household/community water or sanitation service-access mechanism or outcome.
raw_response.rationale: Excluded (E01 - wrong topic). This study is a document analysis of food and nutrition security governance in Eswatini examining nutrition governance strength, policy actors, and multisectoral coordination of nutrition programs. Although sanitation and hygiene are mentioned once in passing among nutrition-sensitive initiatives, the study does not examine household or community water or sanitation service access (C1), rules governing water/sanitation access (C2), or any water/sanitation access outcome (C4).
